RECORDER OF DEEDS
Teresa Allen
Audrain County Courthouse, Room 105
101 N. Jefferson St.
Mexico, Missouri 65265
Phone: 573-473-5830
Office Hours: Monday – Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Email the Recorder of Deeds
Deeds that need to be recorded must be in the Recorder’s office no later than 4:00 PM to ensure recording will be done the same day.
The Audrain County Recorder of Deeds office now offers three new services to our county residents. These include online resources for searching various official records (property and marriage licenses) and alerting you regarding fraudulent activity against your property.
e-Document Filing Online Resources: We have available a variety of methods for online recording of documents from various vendors, including Simplifile , CSC , Indecomm , iCounty , and ePN .
Property Records: Visit their website at Fidlar Laredo/Tapestry
Marriage Certificates (Certified or Uncertified): Visit their website at Official Records Online
Property Fraud Alert : Visit their website at Property Fraud Alert . This service will alert you should any activity be recorded on any properties you’ve listed. Registration is required; however, the service is free.
According to the FBI, property and mortgage fraud is the fastest-growing white-collar crime. It can be as simple as someone recording a fraudulent document in the County Land Records offices, making it look like they now own your home or property. To address these concerns, my office has teamed up to create a notification service that will help you combat the effects of Land fraud and other similar fraudulent activities. Please contact the recorder's office for information on either of these new services.
If you are a Public Notary, please visit this link to learn more about a free service our office is offering in Audrain County. The Notary Fraud Alert monitors the notary’s name and, in some cases, even the commission number within the county’s land records for potential fraud. This is open to all Public Notaries in Audrain County and is free of charge.
The County Recorder of Deeds keeps official records of real estate transfers, deeds of trust, UCC (Chattel Mortgages), subdivision plats, surveys, discharges from armed services, tax liens, and marriage licenses. The earliest records in this office start in 1837. This office records all documents dealing with land transactions in Audrain County. These have been kept since 1837 and indexed by year and name.
Marriage Licenses: Marriage Licenses are now available online at the link in the button below, or you may still apply in person.
Audrain County Marriage License Portal
Apply for a Marriage License in person: Both people must appear to make an application, and you must be in the Recorder’s Office no later than 4:00 pm . You must bring a picture ID (a driver's license will work). If you have your Social Security card, please bring it. We will need to know the judgment date of your last divorce, if applicable. The fee is $59.00, which is paid upon application (Cash Only). The license can be issued on the day of the application and must be used within 30 days after it leaves the Recorder's office. You can complete the application and leave the license in the Recorder's office within 30 days of the marriage ceremony. Marriage records are cross-indexed under the male and female names and have been since 1837. Certified copies of Marriage Licenses are $9.00 each. Please remember the license fee is cash only; thank you. Beginning August 28, 2025: According to Missouri HB737, no one under the age of 18 shall be issued a marriage license, there are no exceptions.
Fees: The cost to record any document except plats, service discharges, and tax liens will be $26.00 for the first page and $3.00 a page for each page following in that document. Copies are $1.00 per page and $1.00 for certification of a document.
Plats: These are $44.00 for the first page and $25.00 for each additional page for an 18 x 24-inch document. Surveys are $24.00 for the first page and $5.00 for each additional page for an 18 x 24-inch document. Please call for more information for larger sizes or if more than one piece of property is surveyed on the survey.
Service Discharges are free to record and to receive copies or certified copies. To get a copy of a service discharge, the requesting individual has to fill out a request form and have their signature notarized before the Recorder of Deeds can look to see if there is a DD 214 filed in the office and to run a copy or certified copy for the requesting party. There is no charge for filing the request, the notary cannot charge for notarizing the request form, and the copies generated by the Recorder of Deeds office are still free. The Regulations for Request Form RSMO 59_480 and the Request for Military Discharge Papers are available on this website and in the Recorder of Deeds office. These new requirements were passed by the Missouri Legislature and went into effect in August 2003.
UCC Filings: As of July 1, 2001, all UCC filings are done at the Missouri Secretary of State's Office. The only UCC filings done on the county level are terminations of old UCC filings or UCC filings that are to be a fixture filing that is recorded in the land records of the Recorder of Deeds' office. The cost to terminate a UCC filing is $6.00. To record a fixture filing, or to continue, assign, amend, or terminate a fixture filing, the cost is $24.00 for the first page and $3.00 for each additional page in a document. You are required to use National UCC filing forms, and you need to put the full legal description of the real estate on the addendum page of the UCC National forms. These forms are available on the Secretary of State's web page. This office still does UCC searches. The cost is $14.00 for the search and up to 10 copies, with a charge of .50 per page after the first ten pages. This request also needs to be on the National UCC forms.
See Document Formatting Standards — Page form and Standard Rejection approved by the Recorders Association of Missouri and the Recorder of Deeds Fee Sheet prepared by the Audrain County Recorder of Deeds.
Federal Tax Liens are $9.00 to file and $7.50 to discharge.
State Tax Liens are $3.00 to file and $1.50 to discharge.
Please contact the Recorder's Office for information on either of these new services.
